title: Mpox Airborne Transmission: A Systematic Review.
abstract: Since May 2022, mpox has been reported across multiple nonendemic regions, with concurrent outbreaks in diverse geographic settings, raising concerns about broader international spread. However, evidence regarding the risk of airborne transmission remains limited. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the risk of airborne transmission and the presence of viable viruses in air samples. PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies published in English, including environmental studies, case reports, cross-sectional studies, and cohort studies. Data extraction included study characteristics (authors, year, design, and setting), sample size, diagnostic methods, participant characteristics, follow-up, type of respiratory particles assessed (droplets and/or aerosols), and key findings. Of 286 records identified, four studies met the inclusion criteria. All were environmental studies published between 2022 and 2023. MPXV DNA was detected in surface and air samples, with cycle threshold (Ct) values ranging from < 30 to < 45. However, none of the studies demonstrated consistent viral viability in aerosols or droplets sufficient to support airborne transmission. Overall, the available evidence is limited and does not support a clear risk of airborne infection. Further well-designed studies in human settings are needed to clarify the potential for mpox transmission through respiratory routes. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: PROSPERO: CRD42023391123.

title: Emerging infectious diseases (Mpox, Nipah, and Andes): A narrative review of transmission, environmental survival, and disinfection
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒是新出现的传染病,导致与医院 传播 相关的 暴发。方法:这篇叙述性综述总结了 猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒 流行病学、临床表现、诊断 和 治疗,重点是环境生存、对防腐剂和消毒剂的敏感性以及感染预防。结果:猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒都可以在环境中生存,并且能够间接感染 传播。所有这些病毒都有包膜,对常用的防腐剂和表面消毒剂敏感。结论:快速识别已知或疑似感染这些新出现病毒的患者,并遵守感染预防建议,将预防与医疗保健相关的 传播。

title: Cross-protective human antibodies against the Mpox virus discovered through structure-guided screening
abstract: Abstract Mpox virus (MPXV) poses an increasing global health threat, as underscored by two World Health Organization declarations of Public Health Emergencies of International Concern, particularly after the emergence of a novel Clade Ib strain that exhibited high human-to-human transmissibility in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. However, the treatment options for MPXV infection remain extremely limited. To address this unmet need, we established an integrated platform combining single-cell transcriptomics and deep learning-based structural prediction to discover effective human monoclonal antibodies against MPXV. By integrating computational prediction with experimental validation, we identified five neutralizing antibodies targeting the following distinct viral forms: BA345, MA42, and MA49, which engage the extracellular enveloped virus-associated A35R glycoprotein; BAL31, which binds intracellular mature virus (IMV) protein A29L; and HB05, which targets IMV antigen H3L. Importantly, the elite monoclonal antibody BA345 conferred effective protection against MPXV and vaccinia virus both in vitro and in vivo. Combined in silico structure prediction and X-ray crystallography revealed a highly conserved epitope shared across orthopoxviruses. Surface plasmon resonance measurements revealed nanomolar equilibrium dissociation constants of BA345 for A35R homologs, corroborating its cross-reactive, broad-spectrum neutralizing activity against orthopoxviruses. Moreover, the BA345/BAL31 and MA49/BAL31 antibody cocktails developed in this study conferred robust therapeutic protection in MPXV-infected animals, substantially reducing disease severity and viral load. Our findings not only establish a practical paradigm for antibody discovery through the integration of deep learning-driven structure prediction with single-cell multiomics but also inform next-generation biodefense countermeasures against MPXV and related orthopoxviruses.

title_zh: 通过结构引导筛选发现针对猴痘病毒的交叉保护性人源单克隆抗体
source_body_en: Abstract Mpox virus (MPXV) poses an increasing global health threat, as underscored by two World Health Organization declarations of Public Health Emergencies of International Concern, particularly after the emergence of a novel Clade Ib strain that exhibited high human-to-human transmissibility in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. However, the treatment options for MPXV infection remain extremely limited. To address this unmet need, we established an integrated platform combining single-cell transcriptomics and deep learning-based structural prediction to discover effective human monoclonal antibodies against MPXV. By integrating computational prediction with experimental validation, we identified five neutralizing antibodies targeting the following distinct viral forms: BA345, MA42, and MA49, which engage the extracellular enveloped virus-associated A35R glycoprotein; BAL31, which binds intracellular mature virus (IMV) protein A29L; and HB05, which targets IMV antigen H3L. Importantly, the elite monoclonal antibody BA345 conferred effective protection against MPXV and vaccinia virus both in vitro and in vivo. Combined in silico structure prediction and X-ray crystallography revealed a highly conserved epitope shared across orthopoxviruses. Surface plasmon resonance measurements revealed nanomolar equilibrium dissociation constants of BA345 for A35R homologs, corroborating its cross-reactive, broad-spectrum neutralizing activity against orthopoxviruses. Moreover, the BA345/BAL31 and MA49/BAL31 antibody cocktails developed in this study conferred robust therapeutic protection in MPXV-infected animals, substantially reducing disease severity and viral load. Our findings not only establish a practical paradigm for antibody discovery through the integration of deep learning-driven structure prediction with single-cell multiomics but also inform next-generation biodefense countermeasures against MPXV and related orthopoxviruses.
abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘病毒(MPXV)对全球健康构成日益严重的威胁,这一点在世界卫生组织两次宣布公共卫生国际关注事件中得到强调,特别是在刚果民主共和国出现了一种新型Clade Ib毒株,该毒株在人与人之间表现出高度传播性之后。然而,针对MPXV感染的治疗选择仍然极其有限。为解决这一未满足的需求,我们建立了一个结合单细胞转录组学和基于深度学习的结构预测的综合平台,以发现有效的针对MPXV的人源单克隆抗体。通过整合计算预测与实验验证,我们鉴定了五种针对以下不同病毒形式的中和抗体:BA345、MA42和MA49,这些抗体靶向与细胞外包膜病毒相关的A35R糖蛋白;BAL31,该抗体结合细胞内成熟病毒(IMV)蛋白A29L;以及HB05,该抗体靶向IMV抗原H3L。重要的是,精英单克隆抗体BA345在体外和体内均对MPXV和天花病毒提供了有效的保护作用。结合计算机模拟结构预测和X射线晶体学分析,我们发现了一种在正痘病毒中高度保守的表位。表面等离子体共振测量显示BA345对A35R同源物的平衡解离常数为纳摩尔级,证实了其对正痘病毒的交叉反应、广谱中和活性。此外,本研究中开发的BA345/BAL31和MA49/BAL31抗体组合在MPXV感染的动物中提供了强大的治疗保护作用,显著降低了疾病严重程度和病毒载量。我们的研究结果不仅通过将深度学习驱动的结构预测与单细胞多组学整合,建立了抗体发现的实用范式,还为针对MPXV及其相关正痘病毒的下一代生物防御对策提供了信息。

title: Structure prediction and drug screening targeting monkeypox virus polymerase and surface proteins
abstract: The global outbreak and ongoing spread of the monkeypox virus (MPXV) have highlighted the urgent need for effective antiviral therapeutics. Here, we integrated artificial intelligence-based protein structure prediction, large-scale virtual screening, and experimental validation to identify preliminary hit compounds targeting MPXV. Using AlphaFold2, we predicted high-accuracy structures for seven essential MPXV proteins, including three polymerase-related and four surface proteins. Molecular docking of these targets against 6405 drugs from the ZINC15 world-approved subset generated a docking score dataset of 44,835 drug-protein pairs, from which numerous high-scoring compounds were identified. Focusing on A35R, we selected 26 compounds for experimental validation using surface plasmon resonance (SPR). Three compounds, including cepharanthine, eltrombopag, and simeprevir, exhibited measurable A35R‐associated binding signals with equilibrium dissociation constants (KD) in the micromolar range. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and molecular mechanics generalized Born surface area were employed for stability analysis and relative energetic assessment. Notably, all three have been previously reported to target other MPXV proteins, reinforcing their potential for repurposing. This work establishes AI‐driven structure prediction as a useful tool for identifying preliminary binding compounds. However, no antiviral activity has been demonstrated for these compounds; therefore, the three hit compounds warrant further optimization and biological evaluation. Our integrated approach provides a framework for rapid drug screening against emerging viral threats.

The findings provide a framework for rapid drug screening against MPXV and other similar viruses.

abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)在全球范围内的暴发传播凸显了开发有效抗病毒药物治疗药物的迫切需求。在此研究中,我们整合了基于人工智能的蛋白质结构预测、大规模虚拟筛选和实验验证,以识别针对MPXV的初步命中化合物。利用AlphaFold2,我们预测了七种关键MPXV蛋白的高精度结构,包括三种与聚合酶相关的蛋白和四种表面蛋白。将这些靶点与ZINC15世界批准药物库中的6405种药物进行分子对接,生成了包含44,835种药物-蛋白配对的对接评分数据集,从中识别出多种高评分化合物。聚焦于A35R蛋白,我们选择了26种化合物进行表面等离子体共振(SPR)实验验证。其中三种化合物,包括长春碱碱(cepharanthine)、 eltrombopag和西米普利韦(simeprevir),显示出与A35R相关的可测量结合信号,其平衡解离常数(KD)处于微摩尔范围内。我们采用分子动力学(MD)模拟和分子力学通用Born表面积方法进行稳定性分析和相对能量评估。值得注意的是,这三种化合物此前已被报道靶向其他MPXV蛋白,这进一步支持了它们的再利用潜力。本研究确立了AI驱动的结构预测作为识别初步结合化合物的有用工具。然而,这些化合物尚未显示出抗病毒药物活性,因此这三种命中化合物需要进一步优化和生物学评估。我们的整合方法为应对新兴病毒威胁的快速药物筛选提供了框架。

title: Unnoticed Entry, Noticed Transmission: Epidemiological Insights into China's First Clade Ib Monkeypox Virus Cluster.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The mpox outbreak caused by Clade Ib monkeypox virus (MPXV) spread rapidly in Central and East Africa and led the World Health Organization to declare the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). In response, China implemented enhanced surveillance measures; nevertheless, an ostensibly asymptomatic returning traveler with repeatedly negative screening tests initiated China's first documented Clade Ib mpox transmission cluster. METHODS: We conducted an epidemiological, clinical, environmental, and genomic investigation to characterize the transmission pattern and inform public health response. Real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), serological testing, and whole-genome sequencing were performed on human and environmental samples to confirm infection and assess viral contamination. RESULTS: Four epidemiologically linked individuals were identified, including 1 imported index case, 2 first-generation confirmed cases resulting from unprotected heterosexual contact with the index case, and 1 suspected second-generation case associated with intimate contact (overnight cosleeping). No fever was documented during clinical assessment or follow-up; 2 cases presented with rash, and 1 had inguinal lymphadenopathy. Whole-genome sequencing confirmed infection with Clade Ib MPXV. All 158 throat swabs collected from general (nonsexual) contacts tested negative. Among 314 environmental samples, 25 of 62 samples collected from case residences were MPXV qPCR positive, whereas all 252 samples from public settings were negative. CONCLUSIONS: These findings demonstrate that Clade Ib mpox transmission can occur from an apparently asymptomatic returning traveler despite repeated negative entry screening, underscoring the limitations of symptom-based or entry-point screening alone and the need for enhanced, risk-based surveillance, diagnostic testing, and targeted prevention strategies.

title_zh: 未被察觉的入境,被察觉的传播:中国首例Clade Ib猴痘病毒聚集的流行病学洞察
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The mpox outbreak caused by Clade Ib monkeypox virus (MPXV) spread rapidly in Central and East Africa and led the World Health Organization to declare the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). In response, China implemented enhanced surveillance measures; nevertheless, an ostensibly asymptomatic returning traveler with repeatedly negative screening tests initiated China's first documented Clade Ib mpox transmission cluster. METHODS: We conducted an epidemiological, clinical, environmental, and genomic investigation to characterize the transmission pattern and inform public health response. Real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), serological testing, and whole-genome sequencing were performed on human and environmental samples to confirm infection and assess viral contamination. RESULTS: Four epidemiologically linked individuals were identified, including 1 imported index case, 2 first-generation confirmed cases resulting from unprotected heterosexual contact with the index case, and 1 suspected second-generation case associated with intimate contact (overnight cosleeping). No fever was documented during clinical assessment or follow-up; 2 cases presented with rash, and 1 had inguinal lymphadenopathy. Whole-genome sequencing confirmed infection with Clade Ib MPXV. All 158 throat swabs collected from general (nonsexual) contacts tested negative. Among 314 environmental samples, 25 of 62 samples collected from case residences were MPXV qPCR positive, whereas all 252 samples from public settings were negative. CONCLUSIONS: These findings demonstrate that Clade Ib mpox transmission can occur from an apparently asymptomatic returning traveler despite repeated negative entry screening, underscoring the limitations of symptom-based or entry-point screening alone and the need for enhanced, risk-based surveillance, diagnostic testing, and targeted prevention strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景:由Clade Ib猴痘病毒(MPXV)引起的暴发在中非和东非地区迅速传播,导致世界卫生组织宣布暴发为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件(PHEIC)。为此,中国实施了加强的监测措施;然而,一名看似无症状的入境旅行者,尽管多次筛查检测结果为阴性,却引发了中国首例记录的Clade Ib 猴痘 传播聚集。方法:我们进行了流行病学、临床、环境和基因组学调查,以描述传播的模式并指导公共卫生响应。对人类和环境样本进行了实时聚合酶链反应(RT-PCR)、血清学检测和全基因组测序,以确认感染并评估病毒污染情况。结果:确定了四名流行病学关联的个体,包括1例输入病例、2例因与输入病例进行无保护的异性接触而确诊的第一代病例,以及1例与亲密接触(整夜共睡)相关的疑似第二代病例。临床评估和随访期间均未记录发热症状;2例病例出现皮疹,1例出现腹股沟淋巴结病。全基因组测序确认感染为Clade Ib MPXV。从一般(非性接触)接触者收集的158份咽拭子样本均呈阴性。在314份环境样本中,从病例住所收集的62份样本中有25份MPXV qPCR检测呈阳性,而从公共环境收集的252份样本均为阴性。结论:这些发现表明,即使多次入境筛查结果为阴性,Clade Ib 猴痘 传播仍可能由看似无症状的入境旅行者引发,突显了仅依赖症状或入境点筛查的局限性,并强调了需要加强基于风险的监测、诊断检测和针对性预防策略的重要性。

title: A human-derived two-antibody cocktail confers prophylactic and therapeutic protection against authentic Mpox virus
abstract: ABSTRACT With sustained human-to-human transmission worldwide, Mpox virus remains a significant global health burden. However, there are no licensed therapeutics against Mpox, with clinical management limited to supportive care and pain management. Given the virus complex life cycles, effective treatments require the inhibition of both mature intracellular virions (MV) and extracellular virions (EV). Here, we describe the isolation of human monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) from antigen specific memory B cell using flow cytometry-based cell sorting. We also characterize the therapeutic potential of 2-mAb cocktails targeting both MV and EV using an in vitro neutralization assay and a mouse challenge model. Several developed human 2-mAb cocktails neutralized authentic Mpox in vitro . When administered 24 hours before or after Mpox challenge, the lead 2-mAb cocktail inhibited viral loads in mouse tissues, with the exception of the testes. Overall, our study identifies several human 2-mAb cocktails with therapeutic potential for controlling Mpox disease. SIGNIFICANCE Mpox virus, which has emerged as a significant public health threat, is now endemic to several countries worldwide. Existing Mpox vaccines offer only partial protection, and the primary antiviral, tecovirimat, has demonstrated no clinical benefits, highlighting an urgent need for novel therapeutics. Recognizing the limitations of animal-derived antibodies for therapeutic use, we isolated human antibodies and demonstrated the therapeutic potential of two-antibody cocktails using an in vitro neutralization assay and a mouse challenge model. Importantly, the two antibodies within our lead cocktail were predicted to bind to conserved epitopes on their Mpox targets. Overall, this study documents the development of a human two-antibody cocktail with both prophylactic and therapeutic potential against Mpox, offering a promising new avenue for clinical intervention.

abstract_original: ABSTRACT With sustained human-to-human transmission worldwide, Mpox virus remains a significant global health burden. However, there are no licensed therapeutics against Mpox, with clinical management limited to supportive care and pain management. Given the virus complex life cycles, effective treatments require the inhibition of both mature intracellular virions (MV) and extracellular virions (EV). Here, we describe the isolation of human monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) from antigen specific memory B cell using flow cytometry-based cell sorting. We also characterize the therapeutic potential of 2-mAb cocktails targeting both MV and EV using an in vitro neutralization assay and a mouse challenge model. Several developed human 2-mAb cocktails neutralized authentic Mpox in vitro . When administered 24 hours before or after Mpox challenge, the lead 2-mAb cocktail inhibited viral loads in mouse tissues, with the exception of the testes. Overall, our study identifies several human 2-mAb cocktails with therapeutic potential for controlling Mpox disease. SIGNIFICANCE Mpox virus, which has emerged as a significant public health threat, is now endemic to several countries worldwide. Existing Mpox vaccines offer only partial protection, and the primary antiviral, tecovirimat, has demonstrated no clinical benefits, highlighting an urgent need for novel therapeutics. Recognizing the limitations of animal-derived antibodies for therapeutic use, we isolated human antibodies and demonstrated the therapeutic potential of two-antibody cocktails using an in vitro neutralization assay and a mouse challenge model. Importantly, the two antibodies within our lead cocktail were predicted to bind to conserved epitopes on their Mpox targets. Overall, this study documents the development of a human two-antibody cocktail with both prophylactic and therapeutic potential against Mpox, offering a promising new avenue for clinical intervention.

abstract_zh: 摘要 随着全球范围内持续存在的人与人之间的 传播,猴痘病毒 仍然是全球重大的健康负担。然而,目前还没有针对 猴痘 的许可疗法,临床管理仅限于支持性护理和疼痛管理。鉴于病毒复杂的生命周期,有效的 治疗 需要抑制成熟的细胞内病毒粒子 (MV) 和细胞外病毒粒子 (EV)。在这里,我们描述了使用基于流式细胞术的细胞分选从抗原特异性记忆 B 细胞中分离人单克隆抗体 (mAb)。我们还使用体外中和测定和小鼠攻击模型来表征针对 MV 和 EV 的 2-mAb 混合物的治疗潜力。几种开发的人类 2-mAb 混合物在体外中和了正宗的 猴痘。在 猴痘 攻击之前或之后 24 小时施用时,先导 2-mAb 混合物可抑制小鼠组织(睾丸除外)中的病毒载量。总体而言,我们的研究确定了几种具有控制 猴痘 疾病治疗潜力的人类 2-mAb 混合物。意义 猴痘病毒 已成为重大公共卫生威胁,目前在全球多个国家流行。现有的 猴痘 疫苗 仅提供部分保护,而主要的 抗病毒药物 特考韦瑞 已证明没有临床益处,这凸显了对新疗法的迫切需要。认识到动物源性抗体在治疗用途上的局限性,我们分离了人类抗体,并使用体外中和测定和小鼠攻击模型证明了两种抗体混合物的治疗潜力。重要的是,我们的先导混合物中的两种抗体预计会与其 猴痘 靶标上的保守表位结合。总体而言,本研究记录了针对 猴痘 具有预防和治疗潜力的人类双抗体混合物的开发,为临床干预提供了一条有前途的新途径。

title: Structure and operating principles of a monkeypox virus replisome
abstract: Abstract Poxviruses are double-stranded DNA viruses with large genomes. Among them, monkeypox virus (MPXV) has been responsible for two recent public health emergencies as declared by the World Health Organization 1 . The MPXV polymerase comprises three subunits—a catalytic subunit (F8) and a heterodimeric processivity factor (A22 and E4). The viral polymerase must coordinate activities with the hexameric helicase–primase (E5) to initiate replication of the viral genome 2 . Although structures of MPXV E5 (refs. 3,4 ) and the polymerase 5–7 in isolation are available, how they assemble into a functional replisome remains unclear. In isolation, E5 is in an autoinhibited conformation and has very weak helicase activity 3,4 , and the mechanism for helicase activation is unclear. Here we used cryo-electron microscopy to determine the structures of DNA-bound MPXV replisomes comprising the polymerase holoenzyme (F8, A22 and E4) and the E5 helicase hexamer. We show that, during replisome assembly, E5 undergoes large-scale conformational changes that allow two of its primase domains to interact with the polymerase F8 thumb and A22 subunit. Biochemical assays and single-molecule experiments reveal that this E5 conformational change is coupled to helicase activation and enhances primase activity. Taken together, these findings identify fundamental mechanisms governing coordinated helicase and polymerase activities during DNA replication for an important class of viral pathogens.

title: Global Asymptotic Stability of a Fractional-Order Model for Mpox Dynamics with Media Effects
abstract: A fractional-order mathematical model is derived for mpox transmission dynamics that explicitly incorporates the influence of public awareness through a new awareness-dependent transmission function. The proposed incidence function models the reduction in disease transmission as the level of awareness increases, thereby capturing the dynamic interaction between epidemic progression and behavioral response. The model further accounts for asymptomatic infection, hospitalization, recovery, and awareness evolution using Caputo fractional derivatives to incorporate memory effects. Basic mathematical properties of the model, including positivity, boundedness, and existence of solutions, are established. The basic reproduction number, R0, is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and a sensitivity analysis is performed to identify the epidemiological parameters that most strongly influence disease transmission. Local and global stability analyses demonstrate that the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable whenever R0 1 and a forward transcritical bifurcation occurs at R0=1. Numerical simulations validate the analytical findings and illustrate the significant role of sustained public awareness in reducing disease transmission and mitigating epidemic outbreaks. The results obtained from the proposed model suggest that combining behavioral awareness strategies with conventional public health interventions can substantially improve the long-term control of mpox.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 开发了分数阶数学模型来模拟 猴痘 传播 动态,纳入无症状感染、住院、康复和意识 进化 等因素。该模型通过数值模拟进行了验证,以说明公众意识对疾病 传播 和 暴发 缓解的影响。

title: ISG15 differentially modulates Clade Ib and II MPXV infection
abstract: The sustained human-to-human transmission of Clade IIb monkeypox virus (MPXV) during the 2022 outbreak underscores the need to define host determinants of viral fitness across species. ISG15 encodes a ubiquitin-like modifier with antiviral activity, yet its role in MPXV infection and host adaptation remains unclear. Using representative strains from Clades Ib and II, we identify a striking species-specific difference in ISG15-mediated restriction. In murine cells, ISG15 deficiency primarily increases viral protein accumulation with minimal effects on infectious viral production, indicating limited antiviral restriction. In contrast, in human cells, ISG15 restricts replication of recent epidemic strains since ISG15 deficiency enhances viral growth, establishing ISG15 as a restriction factor in humans. ISGylome profiling identifies candidate viral and host substrates underlying this effect. Together, these findings reveal species-specific ISG15-dependent control of MPXV infection and support a model in which rodents serve as permissive reservoirs while humans represent a more restrictive host due at least in part to the antiviral activity of human ISG15. We study ISG15 during MPXV infection in human and murine cells. ISG15 deficiency increases infectious virus production in human cells but alters viral protein accumulation in murine cells, and ISGylome analysis identifies ISGylated viral proteins.

abstract_zh: 2022年暴发期间Clade IIb猴痘病毒(MPXV)持续发生人传人传播,凸显了定义跨物种病毒适应性决定因素的必要性。ISG15编码一种具有抗病毒药物活性的泛素样修饰物,但其在MPXV感染和宿主适应中的作用仍不清楚。我们使用来自Clade Ib和II的代表性毒株,发现ISG15介导的限制存在显著的物种特异性差异。在小鼠细胞中,ISG15缺失主要增加病毒蛋白积累,对感染性病毒产量影响较小,表明其限制作用有限。相反,在人类细胞中,ISG15限制了近期流行毒株的复制,因为ISG15缺失会增强病毒生长,确立ISG15作为人类中的限制因子。ISGylome分析鉴定了潜在的病毒和宿主底物。这些发现揭示了ISG15依赖性的物种特异性MPXV感染控制,并支持一个模型,即啮齿动物作为允许的储存宿主,而人类则由于至少部分人类ISG15的抗病毒药物活性,表现出更严格的限制。我们研究了ISG15在人类和小鼠细胞中MPXV感染期间的作用。ISG15缺失在人类细胞中增加感染性病毒产量,但在小鼠细胞中改变病毒蛋白积累,且ISGylome分析鉴定了ISGylated病毒蛋白。

title: Monkeypox Virus Countermeasures: Vaccines, Antibodies, Drugs and Traditional Chinese Medicine
abstract: Abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) has garnered global attention in recent years. MPXV is a DNA virus that is categorized as belonging to the Orthopoxvirus, exhibiting close genetic and structural similarities to variola virus (VARV) and vaccinia virus (VACV). Despite the World Health Organization (WHO) announcing in 2023 that the global outbreak of monkeypox (mpox) is no longer a public health emergency, the new occurrence reported in most regions shows the urgency of the development of medicines for mpox. In this review, we reviewed a huge amount of literature on mpox, summarizing its development, scientific findings, and trustworthy data when it comes to viral structure, binding targets, treatments, and intervention strategies. Because no antiviral agents have been formally authorized by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) or the WHO for the targeted treatment of mpox, coupled with the limited effectiveness demonstrated by current antiviral medications in clinical evaluations, the progressive emergence of drug resistance, and the ongoing threat posed by novel viral variants, the advancement of new antiviral therapeutics for mpox has emerged as an urgent priority within the domain of global public health. The purpose is to explore measures, therapy techniques, and the medication development process for mpox, including vaccines, antibodies, chemicals, natural drug monomers, traditional Chinese medicines (TCM), and Chinese herbal formulations. Also, it clearly differentiates the progress of approved drugs, preclinical candidate compounds, and computer-predicted molecules in the development of therapeutics for mpox. It is beneficial to comprehend MPXV’s research basis, improve the understanding of preventive measures and treatment methods, and promote medical and healthcare services. Keywords: orthopoxvirus, traditional Chinese medicine, therapeutic development

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the Mpox virus, examining vaccines, antibodies, drugs, and traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) as countermeasures. The central question is the development and evaluation of therapeutic interventions for mpox, including their efficacy, safety, and potential for clinical application.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comprehensive analysis of a large body of literature on mpox, summarizing findings related to viral structure, binding targets, treatments, and intervention strategies. It includes a detailed differentiation of approved drugs, preclinical candidate compounds, and computer-predicted molecules in the development of mpox therapeutics.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Despite the WHO declaring the global mpox outbreak no longer a public health emergency in 2023, new occurrences in most regions highlight the urgent need for effective medicines. The review emphasizes the importance of understanding the Mpox virus's biology and the development of new antiviral therapeutics.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that no antiviral agents have been formally authorized by the FDA or WHO for targeted mpox treatment, and current antiviral medications show limited effectiveness in clinical evaluations. Additionally, the progressive emergence of drug resistance and the ongoing threat from novel viral variants are identified as unresolved challenges.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the importance of advancing new antiviral therapeutics for mpox, given the lack of approved treatments and the emergence of drug resistance. It also highlights the need for improved understanding of preventive measures and treatment methods to enhance medical and healthcare services.

analysis.summary_en: This review article explores the development of countermeasures against the Mpox virus, including vaccines, antibodies, drugs, and traditional Chinese medicine. It highlights the urgency of creating effective treatments due to the lack of FDA or WHO-approved antiviral agents and the limited clinical success of current medications. The review summarizes the progress of approved drugs, preclinical candidates, and computer-predicted molecules, while emphasizing the need for further research to address drug resistance and novel viral variants. The findings suggest that improving understanding of mpox's biology and expanding therapeutic options are critical for public health preparedness.

abstract_zh: 摘要: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)近年来引起了全球的关注。MPXV 是一种 DNA 病毒,属于 正痘病毒,与天花病毒 (VARV) 和痘苗病毒 (VACV) 表现出密切的遗传和结构相似性。尽管世界卫生组织(WHO)于2023年宣布全球猴痘病毒(猴痘)不再构成公共卫生紧急事件,但大多数地区报告的新病例显示了开发针对猴痘药物的紧迫性。在这篇综述中,我们回顾了有关猴痘的大量文献,总结了其发展、科学发现以及病毒结构、结合靶点、治疗和干预策略方面的可靠数据。由于美国食品和药物管理局(FDA)或世界卫生组织尚未正式授权抗病毒药物药物用于猴痘的靶向治疗,再加上当前抗病毒药物药物在临床评估中证明的有效性有限,耐药性的逐渐出现以及新型病毒变异体带来的持续威胁,猴痘的新抗病毒药物疗法的进展已经出现全球公共卫生领域的一个紧迫优先事项。目的是探索猴痘的治疗措施、治疗技术和药物开发流程,包括疫苗、抗体、化学物质、天然药物单体、中药和中药制剂。此外,它还清楚地区分了 猴痘 疗法开发中已批准药物、临床前候选化合物和计算机预测分子的进展情况。有利于了解MPXV的研究基础,提高对预防措施和治疗方法的认识,促进医疗保健服务。关键词:正痘病毒,中医,治疗发展

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 鉴于缺乏批准的 治疗 以及耐药性的出现,该审查强调了推进 猴痘 新 抗病毒药物 疗法的重要性。它还强调需要提高对预防措施和治疗方法的理解,以加强医疗保健服务。

title: Rapid diagnosis, genome sequencing and culture isolation of a monkeypox virus of clade Ib from a Ugandan during a professional stay in France
abstract: A new MPXV lineage, clade Ib, was first identified in September 2023 in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Here, we report the fourth imported case of Monkeypox virus (MPXV) clade Ib identified in France and the first publicly available French genome sequence and culture isolate. MPXV clade Ib infection was detected by qPCR and confirmed by a clade Ib-specific qPCR. Whole-genome sequencing using Oxford Nanopore technology and viral culture on Vero E6 cells were both performed in a BSL3 laboratory. Genome classification used Nextclade. Clinical presentation and outcome were without particularites or complications. This case highlights the ongoing international dissemination of MPXV clade Ib and underscores the importance of genomic surveillance and viral isolation for monitoring emerging MPXV lineages in non-endemic countries.

title: Serologic Evidence of Mpox Virus Exposure Among People Living with HIV in Thailand Predating Clinical Recognition during the 2022 Outbreak
abstract: ABSTRACT Objectives Mpox (also known as Monkeypox ) can cause significant morbidity in immunocompromised individuals, as evidenced in multiple recent outbreaks in non-endemic countries. We assessed orthopoxvirus IgG seroprevalence in an at-risk Thai cohort to identify prior exposure and associated clinical/behavioral features. Methods Archived 2022 specimens from an acute HIV cohort were selected based on risk criteria (multiple partners, STI history, or drug use). Samples were tested using the Meso Scale Discovery V-PLEX Orthopoxvirus IgG assay. Demographic, clinical, and behavioral data were analyzed using Mann–Whitney U and Fisher’s exact tests. Results Of 491 participants, 5.5% (27/491) were seropositive. Seropositivity was detected as early as January 2022, predating Thailand’s first clinical case (July 2022) and wastewater detection (June 2022). Only 7.4% (2/27) of seropositive participants had abnormal physical exams. Illicit drug use (74.1%) and meeting multiple behavioral risk criteria were significantly associated with seropositivity ( p < 0.001 and p = 0.029, respectively). No significant differences were found regarding CD4 counts, HIV viral suppression, or concurrent STIs. Conclusions Unrecognized, paucisymptomatic mpox transmission occurred in Thailand months before official detection. These findings highlight the utility of serologic surveillance within established high-risk cohorts for the early detection of emerging infectious threats.

title: Mpox Coinfection with Coxsackie B Virus in a Transgender Host with Well-Controlled HIV
abstract: Background: Mpox (formerly monkeypox) is a double-stranded DNA virus with increasing global prevalence, particularly among men who have sex with men (MSM) and individuals living with HIV. Co-infections with other viruses such as HSV and Varicella have been reported, but no documented cases with Coxsackievirus exist to date. Case: We report the first known case of co-infection with Mpox and Coxsackie B virus in a 30-year-old transgender female with well-controlled HIV. The patient presented with a diffuse painful rash, perianal lesions, rectal pain, and constitutional symptoms. Physical examination revealed characteristic vesiculopustular lesions of Mpox, and laboratory testing confirmed co-infection with Mpox by PCR and Coxsackie B virus by positive serology. The patient improved with supportive care and was discharged with isolation precautions, post-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk close contacts with the JYNNEOS vaccine, and appropriate follow-up recommendations. Discussion: Mpox and Coxsackievirus share overlapping clinical features, complicating early diagnosis, particularly in immunocompromised hosts. While the patient’s HIV was well controlled, her immune profile suggested underlying immune activation, potentially influencing disease severity and presentation. This case highlights the importance of maintaining a broad differential in MSM and HIV-positive populations presenting with a rash and systemic symptoms. Conclusion: This case underscores the need for comprehensive diagnostic evaluation in high-risk patients, including consideration of co-infections. Routine screening and preventive strategies, including vaccination, warrant further study in immunocompromised populations.
journal: Journal of Community Hospital Internal Medicine Perspectives

Co-infections with other viruses such as HSV and Varicella have been reported, but no documented cases with Coxsackievirus exist to date. Case: We report the first known case of co-infection with Mpox and Coxsackie B virus in a 30-year-old transgender female with well-controlled HIV. The patient presented with a diffuse painful rash, perianal lesions, rectal pain, and constitutional symptoms. Physical examination revealed characteristic vesiculopustular lesions of Mpox, and laboratory testing confirmed co-infection with Mpox by PCR and Coxsackie B virus by positive serology. The patient improved with supportive care and was discharged with isolation precautions, post-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk close contacts with the JYNNEOS vaccine, and appropriate follow-up recommendations. Discussion: Mpox and Coxsackievirus share overlapping clinical features, complicating early diagnosis, particularly in immunocompromised hosts. While the patient’s HIV was well controlled, her immune profile suggested underlying immune activation, potentially influencing disease severity and presentation. This case highlights the importance of maintaining a broad differential in MSM and HIV-positive populations presenting with a rash and systemic symptoms. Conclusion: This case underscores the need for comprehensive diagnostic evaluation in high-risk patients, including consideration of co-infections. Routine screening and preventive strategies, including vaccination, warrant further study in immunocompromised populations.
source_records.journal: Journal of Community Hospital Internal Medicine Perspectives

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于单一病例,限制了研究结果的普遍适用性。证据仅限于临床观察和实验室检测,研究结果的可信度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘病毒(以前称为猴痘)是一种双链DNA病毒,其全球发病率正在上升,尤其是在男男性行为者(MSM)和HIV感染者中。已有报告指出与其他病毒如HSV和水痘病毒的共感染情况,但至今尚未有与柯萨奇病毒共感染的记录。病例:我们报告了一例30岁HIV控制良好的跨性别女性中首次发现的猴痘病毒与柯萨奇B病毒共感染病例。患者出现了广泛性疼痛性皮疹、肛周病变、直肠疼痛和全身症状。体格检查发现了猴痘病毒的特征性水疱-脓疱样病变,实验室检测通过PCR确认了猴痘病毒的感染,并通过阳性柯萨奇病毒检测确认了共感染。患者在接受支持性治疗后病情好转,并在隔离预防措施、对高风险密切接触者进行JYNNEOS疫苗的暴露后预防以及适当的随访建议下出院。讨论:猴痘病毒和柯萨奇病毒具有重叠的临床特征,这可能使早期诊断变得复杂,尤其是在免疫功能低下的患者中。尽管患者的HIV得到了良好控制,但其免疫特征表明存在潜在的免疫激活,这可能影响疾病严重程度和表现。该病例强调了在MSM和HIV阳性人群中出现皮疹和全身症状时,保持广泛鉴别诊断的重要性。结论:该病例突显了对高风险患者进行全面诊断评估的必要性,包括考虑共感染的可能性。在免疫功能低下的群体中,常规筛查和预防策略,包括JYNNEOS疫苗,仍需进一步研究。局限性与证据强度:本研究基于单一病例,限制了研究结果的普遍适用性。证据仅限于临床观察和实验室检测,研究结果的可信度中等。

title: Mpox preventive practices and associated factors among adults in a travel-connected setting in Southern Sarawak, Malaysia: a community-based cross-sectional study
abstract: Mpox remains a relevant public health concern in non-endemic, travel-connected settings, where imported cases may occur despite the absence of sustained local transmission. Southern Sarawak, Malaysia, is a socio-demographically diverse region that includes Kuching District, a major administrative and travel hub, and Padawan sub-district, which includes peri-urban and rural communities. This study aimed to assess Mpox preventive practices and factors associated with good preventive practices among adults in Southern Sarawak. A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January to August 2025 among 442 adults in Southern Sarawak, Malaysia. The minimum sample size was estimated using a single-proportion formula and increased by 15% to account for anticipated non-response, including possible refusals, vacant households, and ineligible respondents unavailable during field recruitment. A multistage sampling design was used: Kuching District and Padawan sub-district within Southern Sarawak were purposively selected, residential localities were selected using simple random sampling, households were selected using systematic random sampling, household members were screened for eligibility, and one eligible adult was randomly selected when more than one eligible respondent was present in a household. A structured questionnaire assessed sociodemographic characteristics, Mpox knowledge, attitudes, digital health literacy, and preventive practice. Preventive practice was measured using six Likert-type items covering precautionary measures, quarantine or isolation, avoidance of crowds, mask use and hand hygiene, public awareness, and perceived adequacy of local authority action, and dichotomised as good and poor, with scores ≥ 22 indicating good preventive practice. Knowledge was assessed using 10 items; scores ≥ 7 indicated good knowledge. Attitude was assessed using seven Likert-scale items; scores ≥ 26 indicated a positive attitude. Digital health literacy was assessed using 10 items adapted from the HLS19-DIGI framework, with scores ≥ 76.19% classified as good digital health literacy. Factors associated with good preventive practice were examined using multivariable binary logistic regression. Among the 442 adults who participated, the median age was 37.5 years (IQR: 30–47), 50.5% were male, and 61.8% resided in urban areas. Overall, 95.0% reported good Mpox preventive practice and 95.2% had a positive attitude, although 64.7% had poor Mpox knowledge and 56.3% had good digital health literacy. The final model was statistically significant (χ2(10) = 102.66, p < 0.001) and showed that good preventive practice was independently associated with younger age, male gender, self-employment, unemployment, positive attitude, and good digital health literacy. Adults in Southern Sarawak reported high levels of Mpox preventive practices, but this favourable practice coexisted with poor Mpox-specific knowledge and uneven digital health literacy. Targeted risk communication, strengthening digital health literacy, workplace-based guidance, and locally adapted community engagement are needed to support sustained preventive practice in travel-connected settings.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted risk communication strategies, digital health literacy programs, and community engagement efforts in travel-connected settings to improve Mpox preventive practices. elements_en.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January to August 2025 among 442 adults in Southern Sarawak, Malaysia. Southern Sarawak, Malaysia, is a socio-demographically diverse region that includes Kuching District, a major administrative and travel hub, and Padawan sub-district, which includes peri-urban and rural communities.
elements_en.methods: The study used a multistage sampling design: Kuching District and Padawan sub-district within Southern Sarawak were purposively selected, residential localities were selected using simple random sampling, households were selected using systematic random sampling, household members were screened for eligibility, and one eligible adult was randomly selected when more than one eligible respondent was present in a household. Preventive practice was measured using six Likert-type items covering precautionary measures, quarantine or isolation, avoidance of crowds, mask use and hand hygiene, public awareness, and perceived adequacy of local authority action, and dichotomised as good and poor, with scores ≥ 22 indicating good preventive practice.
elements_en.main_results: Among the 442 adults who participated, the median age was 37.5 years (IQR: 30–47), 50.5% were male, and 61.8% resided in urban areas. Overall, 95.0% reported good Mpox preventive practice and 95.2% had a positive attitude, although 64.7% had poor Mpox knowledge and 56.3% had good digital health literacy. The final model was statistically significant (χ2(10) = 102.66, p < 0.001) and showed that good preventive practice was independently associated with younger age, male gender, self-employment, unemployment, positive attitude, and good digital health literacy.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that high levels of Mpox preventive practices coexisted with poor Mpox-specific knowledge and uneven digital health literacy. The findings highlight the need for targeted risk communication, strengthening digital health literacy, workplace-based guidance, and locally adapted community engagement to support sustained preventive practice in travel-connected settings.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted risk communication strategies, digital health literacy programs, and community engagement efforts in travel-connected settings to improve Mpox preventive practices. They also suggest that improving knowledge and digital health literacy may be critical to maintaining high levels of preventive behavior.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and by the potential for self-reporting bias. The evidence is moderate, as the study provides descriptive data on preventive practices and associated factors but does not include longitudinal or interventional data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估猴痘预防措施及与良好预防措施相关因素在马来西亚南部沙捞越地区成年人中的情况。猴痘在非流行地区、旅行相关环境中仍然是重要的公共卫生问题,尽管当地没有持续的传播传播,仍可能发生输入病例。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年1月至8月期间,对马来西亚南部沙捞越地区的442名成年人进行了基于社区的横断面研究。马来西亚南部沙捞越地区是一个社会人口多样性较高的地区,包括主要的行政和旅行中心基廷区,以及包括郊区和农村社区的帕达万次区。
elements_zh.methods: 研究采用了多阶段抽样设计:首先,有目的地选择了南部沙捞越地区的基廷区和帕达万次区,然后通过简单随机抽样选择居住社区,通过系统随机抽样选择家庭,对家庭成员进行资格筛查,并在每个家庭中有多名合格受访者时随机选择一名合格的成年人。预防措施通过六个李克特量表项目进行测量,涵盖预防措施、隔离或检疫、避免人群聚集、口罩使用和手卫生、公众意识以及对地方政府行动的感知充分性,并将其分为良好和较差两类,得分≥22表示良好的预防措施。
elements_zh.main_results: 在442名参与的成年人中,中位年龄为37.5岁(IQR:30–47),50.5%为男性,61.8%居住在城市地区。总体而言,95.0%的受访者报告了良好的猴痘预防措施,95.2%具有积极态度,尽管64.7%的受访者知识较差,56.3%具有良好的数字健康素养。最终模型统计学上显著(χ2(10) = 102.66,p < 0.001),显示良好的预防措施与年轻年龄、男性性别、自营职业、失业、积极态度和良好的数字健康素养独立相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,高水平的猴痘预防措施与较差的猴痘相关知识和不均衡的数字健康素养并存。研究结果强调了在旅行相关环境中,需要有针对性的风险沟通、加强数字健康素养、基于工作场所的指导以及本地适应的社区参与,以支持持续的预防措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为旅行相关环境中针对性的风险沟通策略、数字健康素养项目以及社区参与活动提供信息,以改善猴痘预防措施。此外,研究还表明,提高知识和数字健康素养可能是维持高水平预防行为的关键。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系,并且可能存在自我报告偏差。证据强度中等,因为研究提供了关于预防措施及其相关因素的描述性数据,但未包括纵向或干预性数据。

title_zh: 猴痘预防措施及相关因素在马来西亚南部沙捞越地区旅行相关环境中成年人中的研究:一项基于社区的横断面研究
source_body_en: Mpox remains a relevant public health concern in non-endemic, travel-connected settings, where imported cases may occur despite the absence of sustained local transmission. Southern Sarawak, Malaysia, is a socio-demographically diverse region that includes Kuching District, a major administrative and travel hub, and Padawan sub-district, which includes peri-urban and rural communities. This study aimed to assess Mpox preventive practices and factors associated with good preventive practices among adults in Southern Sarawak. A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted from January to August 2025 among 442 adults in Southern Sarawak, Malaysia. The minimum sample size was estimated using a single-proportion formula and increased by 15% to account for anticipated non-response, including possible refusals, vacant households, and ineligible respondents unavailable during field recruitment. A multistage sampling design was used: Kuching District and Padawan sub-district within Southern Sarawak were purposively selected, residential localities were selected using simple random sampling, households were selected using systematic random sampling, household members were screened for eligibility, and one eligible adult was randomly selected when more than one eligible respondent was present in a household. A structured questionnaire assessed sociodemographic characteristics, Mpox knowledge, attitudes, digital health literacy, and preventive practice. Preventive practice was measured using six Likert-type items covering precautionary measures, quarantine or isolation, avoidance of crowds, mask use and hand hygiene, public awareness, and perceived adequacy of local authority action, and dichotomised as good and poor, with scores ≥ 22 indicating good preventive practice. Knowledge was assessed using 10 items; scores ≥ 7 indicated good knowledge. Attitude was assessed using seven Likert-scale items; scores ≥ 26 indicated a positive attitude. Digital health literacy was assessed using 10 items adapted from the HLS19-DIGI framework, with scores ≥ 76.19% classified as good digital health literacy. Factors associated with good preventive practice were examined using multivariable binary logistic regression. Among the 442 adults who participated, the median age was 37.5 years (IQR: 30–47), 50.5% were male, and 61.8% resided in urban areas. Overall, 95.0% reported good Mpox preventive practice and 95.2% had a positive attitude, although 64.7% had poor Mpox knowledge and 56.3% had good digital health literacy. The final model was statistically significant (χ2(10) = 102.66, p < 0.001) and showed that good preventive practice was independently associated with younger age, male gender, self-employment, unemployment, positive attitude, and good digital health literacy. Adults in Southern Sarawak reported high levels of Mpox preventive practices, but this favourable practice coexisted with poor Mpox-specific knowledge and uneven digital health literacy. Targeted risk communication, strengthening digital health literacy, workplace-based guidance, and locally adapted community engagement are needed to support sustained preventive practice in travel-connected settings.

title: Comparison of diagnostic performance between the World Health Organization and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention real-time PCR assays for molecular detection of the mpox virus
abstract: ABSTRACT The global emergence and spread of monkeypox (mpox) have underscored the need for accurate and reliable molecular diagnostic tools. Real-time PCR remains the reference method for detecting mpox virus (MPXV); however, variations among available protocols may affect diagnostic performance. The objective of this study was to compare the diagnostic accuracy of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the USA real-time PCR assay with the World Health Organization (WHO) reference molecular protocol, using clinical samples from Ecuador. A retrospective analysis was conducted on 300 specimens from suspected mpox cases, including lesion swabs, vesicular samples, and serum, of which 150 were previously confirmed as MPXV-positive and 150 as MPXV-negative by the WHO assay. DNA was extracted using a standardized protocol, and all samples were tested with the CDC assay. The CDC protocol correctly identified 291 of 300 samples, yielding 141 true positives, 150 true negatives, 9 false negatives, and no false positives. The overall agreement was 97% (95% CI: 94–98), with a sensitivity of 94% (95% CI: 89–97) and a specificity of 100% (95% CI: 98–100). The positive predictive value was 100%, and the negative predictive value was 94% (95% CI: 90–97). The Cohen’s kappa coefficient obtained was 0.94 (95% CI: 0.90-0.98). These findings demonstrate that the CDC real-time PCR assay provides high diagnostic accuracy and excellent specificity for MPXV detection compared with the WHO reference protocol, supporting the use of both CDC and WHO real-time PCR assays as reliable diagnostic tools in clinical and surveillance settings. IMPORTANCE The global emergence and spread of MPXV have underscored the need for accurate PCR diagnostic tools. This is the first study to address a comparison between the PCR protocols for MPXV from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the USA real-time PCR assay and the World Health Organization (WHO), two institutions globally acknowledged as references for infectious disease diagnosis. We show that both PCR protocols are very reliable for MPXV diagnosis and could be implemented for any laboratory worldwide indistinctly.

title_zh: 世界卫生组织与疾病控制和预防中心 猴痘病毒 分子检测实时 PCR 检测的诊断性能比较
source_body_en: ABSTRACT The global emergence and spread of monkeypox (mpox) have underscored the need for accurate and reliable molecular diagnostic tools. Real-time PCR remains the reference method for detecting mpox virus (MPXV); however, variations among available protocols may affect diagnostic performance. The objective of this study was to compare the diagnostic accuracy of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the USA real-time PCR assay with the World Health Organization (WHO) reference molecular protocol, using clinical samples from Ecuador. A retrospective analysis was conducted on 300 specimens from suspected mpox cases, including lesion swabs, vesicular samples, and serum, of which 150 were previously confirmed as MPXV-positive and 150 as MPXV-negative by the WHO assay. DNA was extracted using a standardized protocol, and all samples were tested with the CDC assay. The CDC protocol correctly identified 291 of 300 samples, yielding 141 true positives, 150 true negatives, 9 false negatives, and no false positives. The overall agreement was 97% (95% CI: 94–98), with a sensitivity of 94% (95% CI: 89–97) and a specificity of 100% (95% CI: 98–100). The positive predictive value was 100%, and the negative predictive value was 94% (95% CI: 90–97). The Cohen’s kappa coefficient obtained was 0.94 (95% CI: 0.90-0.98). These findings demonstrate that the CDC real-time PCR assay provides high diagnostic accuracy and excellent specificity for MPXV detection compared with the WHO reference protocol, supporting the use of both CDC and WHO real-time PCR assays as reliable diagnostic tools in clinical and surveillance settings. IMPORTANCE The global emergence and spread of MPXV have underscored the need for accurate PCR diagnostic tools. This is the first study to address a comparison between the PCR protocols for MPXV from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the USA real-time PCR assay and the World Health Organization (WHO), two institutions globally acknowledged as references for infectious disease diagnosis. We show that both PCR protocols are very reliable for MPXV diagnosis and could be implemented for any laboratory worldwide indistinctly.
abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘 (猴痘) 在全球的出现和传播凸显了对准确可靠的分子诊断工具的需求。实时PCR仍然是检测猴痘病毒 (MPXV)的参考方法;然而,可用协议之间的差异可能会影响诊断性能。本研究的目的是使用厄瓜多尔的临床样本,比较美国疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC) 实时 PCR 检测与世界卫生组织 (WHO) 参考分子方案的诊断准确性。对疑似 猴痘 病例的 300 份标本进行回顾性分析,包括病灶拭子、水泡样本和血清,其中 150 份先前经 WHO 检测确认为 MPXV 阳性,150 份为 MPXV 阴性。使用标准化方案提取 DNA,并使用 CDC 检测对所有样本进行测试。CDC 协议正确识别了 300 个样本中的 291 个,产生 141 个真阳性、150 个真阴性、9 个假阴性,没有假阳性。总体一致性为 97% (95% CI: 94–98),敏感性为 94% (95% CI: 89–97),特异性为 100% (95% CI: 98–100)。阳性预测值为100%,阴性预测值为94%(95% CI:90-97)。获得的科恩卡帕系数为 0.94(95% CI:0.90-0.98)。这些研究结果表明,与 WHO 参考方案相比,CDC 实时 PCR 检测为 MPXV 检测提供了高诊断准确性和出色的特异性,支持将 CDC 和 WHO 实时 PCR 检测用作临床和 监测 设置中的可靠诊断工具。重要性 MPXV 在全球的出现和传播凸显了对准确 PCR 诊断工具的需求。这是第一项对美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 实时 PCR 检测和世界卫生组织 (WHO) 的 MPXV PCR 方案进行比较的研究,这两个机构是全球公认的传染病参考文献 诊断。我们表明,两种 PCR 方案对于 MPXV 诊断 都非常可靠,并且可以在全球任何实验室中实施。

title: MONKEYPOX TRANSMISSION DYNAMICS IN A POPULATION OF MEN WHO HAVE SEX WITH MEN: A MATHEMATICAL MODELLING APPROACH
abstract: The spread of monkeypox within a human population is investigated in this study using a mathematical model that incorporates the administration of two vaccine doses.The model's fundamental properties including the nonnegativity and boundedness of its solutions are established to ensure its biological and epidemiological significance.The effective reproduction number, an important threshold for assessing disease transmission, is derived using the next generation matrix operator and used to analyse the conditions for the existence of equilibrium states of the model.In addition, the normalized forward sensitivity is performed on the effective reproduction number to identify parameters that strongly influence the spread of the disease in the population.The results provides useful insights into effective control strategies and appropriate intervention measures in reducing monkeypox transmission within the population IARJSET

The study's findings are significant for informing public health approaches in high-risk groups. However, the reliance on a mathematical model without empirical data limits the strength of the evidence to moderate. title: Mpox outbreak associated with multiple sexual partnerships and HIV coinfection in Masaka District, Uganda, February–April 2025
abstract: Background Uganda experienced a substantial increase in mpox cases in early 2025, with notable clustering in central regions. Masaka district reported approximately 4,800 confirmed mpox cases and 37 deaths, contributing approximately 3% of the national burden. We investigated an outbreak in Masaka District to describe its epidemiology and identify associated risk factors. Methods We conducted an outbreak investigation with a descriptive epidemiological analysis and an unmatched case–control study. A suspected case was defined as onset of rash with fever and at least one additional symptom (lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgia, back pain, or fatigue) in a Masaka District resident during February–April 2025. Confirmed cases were PCR-positive. We enrolled 86 confirmed cases and 172 neighborhood controls (1:2 ratio). Data on sociodemographic characteristics, care-seeking behavior, and potential exposures were collected using structured questionnaires. Multivariable logistic regression identified independent risk factors. Results Of the 86 confirmed cases, 45 (52.3%) were male and 41 (47.7%) were female. The most affected age group was 25-34 years (24 per 10,000 population), and residents of Bukakata Sub-county, a fisherfolk community, had the highest attack rate (5 per 10,000). Over half (56%) were HIV positive. Independent risk factors included HIV infection (aOR: 5.4; 95% CI: 2.3–12.5), having multiple sexual partners (aOR: 7.3; 95% CI: 3.5–15.3), and close contact with an individual with a rash (aOR: 3.2; 95% CI: 1.4–6.9). Conclusion The Mpox outbreak affected young adults, driven by high-risk sexual networks and underlying HIV infection. Strengthening integration of Mpox screening, prevention, and care within HIV programs targeting sexual networks could interrupt transmission and mitigate future outbreaks.

abstract_zh: 背景 乌干达在2025年初经历了猴痘病例的显著增加,其中在中部地区出现了明显的聚集现象。马萨卡区报告了约4,800例确认的猴痘病例和37例死亡,占全国负担的约3%。我们对马萨卡区的暴发进行了调查,以描述其流行病学并确定相关风险因素。方法 我们进行了暴发调查,采用描述性流行病学分析和非配对病例对照研究。疑似病例定义为2025年2月至4月期间,马萨卡区居民出现皮疹伴发热,并至少伴有淋巴结肿大、头痛、肌肉疼痛、背痛或疲劳等症状。确诊病例为PCR阳性。我们纳入了86例确诊病例和172例社区对照(1:2比例)。通过结构化问卷收集了有关社会人口学特征、就医行为和潜在暴露的数据。多变量逻辑回归分析确定了独立风险因素。结果 在86例确诊病例中,45例(52.3%)为男性,41例(47.7%)为女性。受影响最严重的年龄组为25-34岁(每10,000人中有24例),而布卡卡塔子县(一个渔民社区)的居民攻击率最高(每10,000人中有5例)。超过一半(56%)的病例为HIV阳性。独立风险因素包括HIV感染(aOR:5.4;95% CI:2.3–12.5)、有多个性伴侣(aOR:7.3;95% CI:3.5–15.3)以及与有皮疹者密切接触(aOR:3.2;95% CI:1.4–6.9)。结论 猴痘 暴发主要影响年轻人,其传播主要由高风险性网络传播和HIV感染驱动。加强针对性网络的HIV项目中猴痘的筛查、预防和护理,可以中断传播并减轻未来的暴发。

title: ANALYSE MULTIVARIÉE DES PROFILS ÉPIDÉMIOLOGIQUES DE LA MPOX À L’ÉCHELLE INTERNATIONALE PAR ANALYSE EN COMPOSANTES PRINCIPALES : Positionnement de la République Démocratique du Congo
abstract: This paper presents a descriptive multivariate analysis of international mpox epidemiological profiles using principal component analysis (PCA). The dataset was obtained from the Our World in Data mpox database, derived from World Health Organization data, and covers the period from 1 May 2022 to 28 February 2026. After removing regional and global aggregates, checking ISO codes, handling missing values, and constructing country-level indicators, 144 countries and territories were retained. Fifteen variables describing cumulative burden, mortality, peak intensity, temporal dispersion, and duration of circulation were analyzed. Bartlett’s test of sphericity (χ2 = 2972.55; p < 0.001) and the overall KMO index (0.668) supported the use of exploratory PCA. The first three components explained 71.55% of the total variance. The first component mainly represented observed intensity and severity, the second duration and persistence of circulation, and the third the contrast between case burden and death burden. The applied contribution of the study lies in transforming daily surveillance series into a reproducible country-by-indicator matrix and positioning the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the international factorial space. The Democratic Republic of the Congo had a high PC1 score and a positive PC2 score, consistent with a profile of high reported burden and sustained circulation. This interpretation remains descriptive and depends on the quality of national surveillance systems.

title_zh: 国际猴痘流行病学特征的多变量分析:刚果民主共和国的位置
source_body_en: This paper presents a descriptive multivariate analysis of international mpox epidemiological profiles using principal component analysis (PCA). The dataset was obtained from the Our World in Data mpox database, derived from World Health Organization data, and covers the period from 1 May 2022 to 28 February 2026. After removing regional and global aggregates, checking ISO codes, handling missing values, and constructing country-level indicators, 144 countries and territories were retained. Fifteen variables describing cumulative burden, mortality, peak intensity, temporal dispersion, and duration of circulation were analyzed. Bartlett’s test of sphericity (χ2 = 2972.55; p < 0.001) and the overall KMO index (0.668) supported the use of exploratory PCA. The first three components explained 71.55% of the total variance. The first component mainly represented observed intensity and severity, the second duration and persistence of circulation, and the third the contrast between case burden and death burden. The applied contribution of the study lies in transforming daily surveillance series into a reproducible country-by-indicator matrix and positioning the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the international factorial space. The Democratic Republic of the Congo had a high PC1 score and a positive PC2 score, consistent with a profile of high reported burden and sustained circulation. This interpretation remains descriptive and depends on the quality of national surveillance systems.
abstract_zh: 本文采用主成分分析(PCA)对国际猴痘流行病学特征进行了描述性多变量分析。数据集来源于Our World in Data 猴痘数据库,该数据库基于世界卫生组织数据,涵盖2022年5月1日至2026年2月28日的时间段。在去除区域和全球汇总数据、检查ISO代码、处理缺失值并构建国家层面指标后,保留了144个国家和地区。分析了15个变量,包括累积负担、死亡率、峰值强度、时间分散性和传播持续时间。巴特利特球形度检验(χ2 = 2972.55;p < 0.001)和总体KMO指数(0.668)支持了探索性PCA的应用。前三个主成分解释了总方差的71.55%。第一个主成分主要代表观察到的强度和严重程度,第二个主成分代表传播的持续时间和持久性,第三个主成分则代表病例负担与死亡负担之间的对比。本研究的贡献在于将每日监测系列数据转化为可重复的国家-指标矩阵,并将刚果民主共和国定位在国际因子空间中。刚果民主共和国具有较高的PC1得分和正的PC2得分,与高报告负担和持续传播的特征一致。这种解释仍保持描述性,并依赖于国家监测系统的质量。

title: Knowledge and attitude of monkeypox among medical students
abstract: BACKGROUND: Monkeypox virus is one of the zoonotic diseases which endemic in Central and Western Africa with a few outbreaks spreading in multiple countries in 2022. The aim of this study was to evaluate human monkeypox knowledge and attitude regarding human monkeypox among medical students.METHODS: A cross-sectional online survey was done from October 2022 to May 2023 to assess knowledge, attitude of Mpox among 281 medical students in Iraqi medical college. Medical students’ participants were informed that the study was anonymous and done through online Google form questionnaire.RESULTS: The total participants students in this study were 281 who studied at Al-kindy College of Medicine in different stages. Females were constituted 63.7% and the rest were males (36.3%). Their knowledge about this disease was caused by viral infection (91.8%) and transmitted through direct contact with infected person (52.3%) and infected animal like monkeys (29.9%). Students information about reservoir were Sooty Mangabey monkey (Cercocebusatys) (46.3%) with clinical manifestation of the patient were fever (36.7%), rash (23.5%), lesion in the palm and sole (17.4%), and the least ones were fatigue and lymphadenopathy. They thought that treatment of this disease through using antiviral drugs (76.5%) and (23.5%) believed its self-limiting disease and vaccine prevent this disease (68%) and (32%) supposed no effective vaccine was present. Their attitude about the prognosis of this disease was fatal disease (60.1%) and the rest (39.9%) was not fatal.CONCLUSIONS: The current study showed a generally satisfactory levels of knowledge and information’s regarding disease among university students.
journal: Gazzetta Medica Italiana Archivio per le Scienze Mediche

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate knowledge and attitude of monkeypox among medical students, as monkeypox virus is a zoonotic disease endemic in Central and Western Africa with outbreaks spreading globally in 2022.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional online survey was conducted from October 2022 to May 2023 among 281 medical students at Al-kindy College of Medicine in Iraq. Participants were informed that the study was anonymous and administered through an online Google form questionnaire.
analysis.methods: The study used an anonymous online Google form questionnaire to assess knowledge and attitude of monkeypox among medical students. The survey was conducted from October 2022 to May 2023.
analysis.main_results: Among the participants, 63.7% were female and 36.3% were male. Students correctly identified monkeypox as a viral infection (91.8%) and recognized transmission through direct contact with infected persons (52.3%) and animals like monkeys (29.9%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights that medical students have a generally satisfactory understanding of monkeypox, including its causative agent and transmission routes, which is a novel finding in the context of educational institutions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted educational interventions may be effective in improving knowledge about monkeypox, which could inform public health strategies for disease prevention and control.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data from an anonymous online survey, which may introduce bias. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the cross-sectional design and lack of longitudinal data.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the knowledge and attitude of medical students toward monkeypox virus, a zoonotic disease endemic in Central and Western Africa. Conducted as a cross-sectional online survey from October 2022 to May 2023, the research involved 281 students at Al-kindy College of Medicine in Iraq. The survey revealed that most students correctly identified monkeypox as a viral infection and recognized its transmission routes. The study found that females constituted 63.7% of participants, with a majority correctly identifying the virus as transmitted through direct contact with infected individuals and animals like monkeys. The findings suggest that medical students have a generally satisfactory understanding of monkeypox, which could inform public health strategies. However, the study's reliance on self-reported data and cross-sectional design limits the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘病毒是中非和西非流行的人畜共患疾病之一,2022年少数暴发在多个国家传播。本研究旨在评估医学生对人猴痘的知识和态度。方法:于2022年10月至2023年5月进行横断面在线调查,评估281名医学生对猴痘的知识和态度。在伊拉克医学院。医学生参与者被告知该研究是匿名的,并通过在线谷歌表格问卷完成。结果:本研究的参与者总数为 281 名在阿尔金迪医学院不同阶段学习的学生。女性占63.7%,其余为男性(36.3%)。他们对这种疾病的了解是由病毒感染引起的(91.8%),并通过直接接触感染者(52.3%)和受感染的动物如猴子(29.9%)传播。储存宿主的学生信息为乌白眉猴(Cercocebusatys)(46.3%),患者临床表现为发热(36.7%)、皮疹(23.5%)、手掌和足底病变(17.4%),最少的是疲劳和淋巴结肿大。他们认为治疗通过使用抗病毒药物药物来治疗这种疾病(76.5%)和(23.5%)认为其是自限性疾病,而疫苗可以预防这种疾病(68%)和(32%)认为不存在有效的疫苗。他们对该疾病预后的态度是致命性疾病(60.1%),其余(39.9%)不是致命性疾病。结论:本研究表明大学生对疾病的知识和信息水平总体令人满意。

title: Neural network-based modeling of monkeypox patient status using clinical and demographic characteristics
abstract: ABSTRACT Background Monkeypox (Mpox) has emerged as a growing public health concern, requiring effective tools for early patient risk assessment and clinical decision-making. This study aimed to develop an artificial intelligence (AI)-based machine learning framework using a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network to analyze a Mpox dataset collected from 11 non-endemic countries, identify the most significant clinical symptoms, investigate the relationships among travel history, hospitalization, isolation, and infection status, and predict the hospitalization and isolation status of Mpox patients. Methods A total of 365 non-severe Mpox cases from 11 non-endemic countries were included in the analysis provided in publicly available World Health Organization (WHO) reports from May 6 to May 29, 2022. Patients were classified into two groups: Hospitalized and isolated patients. Clinical data were converted to binary dummy variables and demographic and travel-history data were added as features. The data were analyzed using cross-tabulation and descriptive visualization for symptom patterns and relationships between clinical and demographic variables. A supervised AI-based MLP neural network was then developed to predict the status of hospitalization and isolation, and the performance of the model was assessed by accuracy, recall, false omission rate (FOR) and F1 score. Results The symptoms most commonly reported in the analysis included genital ulcers, fever, and lesions. The eleven countries included in the study reported varying symptom patterns, with Argentina showing the highest symptom diversity, with up to four symptoms recorded per case.. The overall training accuracy of the proposed MLP neural network for the prediction of hospitalization was 94.7% and the overall testing accuracy was 90.7%. The model showed good predictive performance for each patient status classification task with an accuracy of 94.2% at training phase and 90.1% at test phase for isolation prediction. Conclusion The proposed AI-based multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network provides an effective approach for predicting the hospitalization and isolation status of Mpox patients using clinical and demographic variables. Symptom distributions varied across countries, indicating regional heterogeneity in disease presentation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘(猴痘)已成为日益严重的公共卫生问题,需要有效的工具来进行早期患者风险评估和临床决策。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究旨在利用多层感知器(MLP)神经网络开发一种基于人工智能(AI)的机器学习框架,分析从11个非流行区国家收集的猴痘数据集,识别最重要的临床症状,探讨旅行史、住院、隔离和感染状态之间的关系,并预测猴痘患者的住院和隔离状态。
elements_zh.methods: 从2022年5月6日至5月29日公开的世卫组织(WHO)报告中,纳入了来自11个非流行区国家的365例非严重猴痘病例。临床数据被转换为二元虚拟变量,人口统计学和旅行史数据被作为特征添加。随后,开发了一个监督式AI基于的MLP神经网络来预测住院和隔离状态,并通过准确率、召回率、漏诊率(FOR)和F1分数评估模型性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 分析中报告的最常见症状包括生殖器溃疡、发热和皮疹。研究中包含的11个国家报告了不同的症状模式,其中阿根廷表现出最高的症状多样性,每例病例最多记录四种症状。所提出的MLP神经网络在住院预测的训练总体准确率为94.7%,测试总体准确率为90.7%。对于隔离预测的每个患者状态分类任务,模型在训练阶段的准确率为94.2%,在测试阶段的准确率为90.1%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 所提出的基于人工智能的多层感知器(MLP)神经网络为利用临床和人口统计学变量预测猴痘患者的住院和隔离状态提供了一种有效的方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于开发预测猴痘患者状态的工具,有助于临床决策和患者护理资源的分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 症状分布因国家而异,表明疾病表现存在地区异质性。由于研究基于公开的WHO报告,且未包含详细的生物学或病毒学分析,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 猴痘(猴痘)已成为日益严重的公共卫生问题,需要有效的工具来进行早期患者风险评估和临床决策。本研究旨在利用多层感知器(MLP)神经网络开发一种基于人工智能(AI)的机器学习框架,分析从11个非流行区国家收集的猴痘数据集,识别最重要的临床症状,探讨旅行史、住院、隔离和感染状态之间的关系,并预测猴痘患者的住院和隔离状态。方法 从2022年5月6日至5月29日公开的世卫组织(WHO)报告中,纳入了来自11个非流行区国家的365例非严重猴痘病例。患者被分为两类:住院患者和隔离患者。临床数据被转换为二元虚拟变量,人口统计学和旅行史数据被作为特征添加。通过交叉列联表和描述性可视化分析症状模式及临床和人口统计学变量之间的关系。随后,开发了一个监督式AI基于的MLP神经网络来预测住院和隔离状态,并通过准确率、召回率、漏诊率(FOR)和F1分数评估模型性能。结果 分析中报告的最常见症状包括生殖器溃疡、发热和皮疹。研究中包含的11个国家报告了不同的症状模式,其中阿根廷表现出最高的症状多样性,每例病例最多记录四种症状。所提出的MLP神经网络在住院预测的训练总体准确率为94.7%,测试总体准确率为90.7%。对于隔离预测的每个患者状态分类任务,模型在训练阶段的准确率为94.2%,在测试阶段的准确率为90.1%。结论 所提出的基于人工智能的多层感知器(MLP)神经网络为利用临床和人口统计学变量预测猴痘患者的住院和隔离状态提供了一种有效的方法。症状分布因国家而异,表明疾病表现存在地区异质性。

analysis_zh.methods: 从2022年5月6日至5月29日公开的世卫组织(WHO)报告中,纳入了来自11个非流行区国家的365例非严重猴痘病例。临床数据被转换为二元虚拟变量,人口统计学和旅行史数据被作为特征添加。随后,开发了一个监督式AI基于的MLP神经网络来预测住院和隔离状态,并通过准确率、召回率、漏诊率(FOR)和F1分数评估模型性能。
analysis_zh.main_results: 分析中报告的最常见症状包括生殖器溃疡、发热和皮疹。研究中包含的11个国家报告了不同的症状模式,其中阿根廷表现出最高的症状多样性,每例病例最多记录四种症状。所提出的MLP神经网络在住院预测的训练总体准确率为94.7%,测试总体准确率为90.7%。对于隔离预测的每个患者状态分类任务,模型在训练阶段的准确率为94.2%,在测试阶段的准确率为90.1%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 所提出的基于人工智能的多层感知器(MLP)神经网络为利用临床和人口统计学变量预测猴痘患者的住院和隔离状态提供了一种有效的方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于开发预测猴痘患者状态的工具,有助于临床决策和患者护理资源的分配。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 症状分布因国家而异,表明疾病表现存在地区异质性。由于研究基于公开的WHO报告,且未包含详细的生物学或病毒学分析,证据强度中等。

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
journal: Recent Advances in Computer Science and Communications

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the urgent public-health need for rapid, accurate diagnostic tools to mitigate the global outbreak risk of mpox, highlighting that existing methods are slow and deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class skin lesion classification.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors developed and evaluated a deep learning framework (HECA-YOLOv11) designed for real-time screening of mpox and similar skin lesions using a four-class image dataset.
analysis.methods: The proposed architecture integrates a Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11, applying Global Average Pooling and Max Average Pooling to input feature maps, and augments a dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements.
analysis.main_results: On the test set, HECA-YOLOv11 achieved 98.9% accuracy, 99% precision, 99.3% recall, and 99.1% F1-score, outperforming EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, YOLOv11s, SE-YOLOv11, and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all metrics.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques as effectively addressing key limitations in automated skin lesion detection, marking a major advancement toward reliable clinical decision support for early mpox screening.

title_zh: HECA-YOLOv11:一种高精度混合注意力网络,用于实时猴痘皮肤病变检测并具有可解释性
source_body_en: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Characterisation of host cytokine responses to mpox infection and their restrictive capacity
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an orthopoxvirus (OPXV) that re-emerged in 2022 causing significant morbidity worldwide. Mpox disease presents with characteristic skin lesions and systemic inflammatory symptoms. Little is known about how MPXV modulates human innate immunity and cytokine responses, although significant evasion is expected from knowledge obtained from other OPXV. In this study I show that MPXV infection of human keratinocytes results in an inflammatory cytokine response defined by elevated IL-6, IL-8, IL-11 and LIF that was not shared with other OPXV. Genetic manipulation revealed that cytokine induction is dependent on nucleic acid sensing and multiple transcription factors. Activation of human fibroblasts with these cytokines did not restrict viral replication despite activating STAT3. Conversely, activation with IL-1β, TNFα and IFNβ resulted in a reduction of viral foci and significant restriction of MPXV and VACV replication. Furthermore, comparative analysis of cytokine responses highlighted that IL-1β and TNFα upregulate a subset of the ISG proteome and restriction by IL-1β and TNFα was partially alleviated by JAK1/2 inhibitor ruxolitinib, indicating ISG-dependent antiviral activity. Further analysis highlighted that IFN restriction was partly mediated by the transmembrane protein family IFITM, consistent with restriction at the level of establishing infection. Spread assays revealed that IFITMs impair VACV spread, mediated by EEV and restrict viral titres of a range of OPXV. Surprisingly, our study determined that IFITM antagonism is a conserved feature of OPXV infection. Collectively, this work reveals that MPXV has evolved a distinctive interplay with human innate responses characterized by selective modulation of inflammatory and chemotactic signalling whilst retaining effective suppression of antiviral cytokines. Furthermore, preactivating cells with IFN revealed selective antagonism of restrictive ISG by OPXV, indicating that OPXV interactions with the ISG proteome provide a source of novel antiviral factors to be exploited for IFN-based antivirals.
